# Jesus Heals the Bleeding Woman (Matthew 9:22)

## Emotional Focus
When you’ve been hurting a long time and need Jesus to notice.

## Key KJV
“Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole.” (Matthew 9:22)

## Gentle Retelling
A woman had been sick for twelve years. She touched the hem of Jesus’ robe in the crowd. Jesus felt power go out and turned to her with kindness. He said her faith had made her well.

## Coloring Prompt
A woman reaching out to touch the edge of Jesus’ robe in a gentle crowd; peaceful healing light.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus notices even the smallest touch of faith. He makes us well.”
